libraries.name: wins-kernel32
libraries.summary: Files (ANSI/Wide attributes, directory enumeration, extended/drive path normalization), memory, threads and synchronisation (real threads, lock-free critical sections), PE .rsrc resource lookup, x86-64 .pdata table-driven SEH / C++ EH unwinding, time, ini files, console, Windows command-line quoting. Many of the ~900 kernel32 exports are not implemented.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game, Mojave exterior, Pip-Boy UI and underwater/water scenes; the library appears in those runs' loader logs (WINS 8c50dda / 250e2af, 2026-11-15); x86-64 CLI runs on winrun via winrun_box.py: corpus/sqlite3.exe (:memory: SQL queries), corpus/busybox64.exe (banner, echo, printf, sha256sum) and corpus/calcbolge.exe; x86-64 GUI run on winrun_gui: corpus/notepad++.exe startup C++ EH unwind and .rsrc loading (2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-ntdll

libraries.name: wins-msvcrt
libraries.summary: The C runtime a program imports instead of linking statically (x86_64 Win64 ABI vs i386 cdecl ABI; winrun32 adds _beginthreadex/_endthreadex over real threads).
libraries.evidence: corpus/7zr.exe (i386) compress/list/test/extract/benchmark under winrun32; corpus/busybox64.exe (banner, echo, printf, sha256sum) and corpus/calcbolge.exe (stderr error path) under winrun via winrun_box.py (2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-user32
libraries.summary: Window classes, multi-window hierarchy, child controls, message queues, coordinate/rect helpers, LoadStringW, wsprintfW, activation and input messages over a host X11 window. i386 uses wins_user32.zig; the x86-64 GUI loader uses winrun_gui_support.zig.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game, Mojave exterior, Pip-Boy UI and underwater/water scenes; the library appears in those runs' loader logs (WINS 8c50dda / 250e2af, 2026-11-15); x86-64 GUI run on winrun_gui in isolated Xvfb :91: corpus/notepad++.exe creates 20 windows (Notepad++, Scintilla, SysTabControl32, ToolbarWindow32, ReBarWindow32, msctls_statusbar32) and maps 1024x700 X11 window (2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-gdi32
libraries.summary: i386: GetStockObject only. x86-64 GUI loader: software XRGB8888 framebuffer (winrun_gdi_fb.zig) with memory DCs, offscreen bitmaps/DIBs, BitBlt/StretchBlt/PatBlt, brushes/pens/regions, FillRect/FrameRect/Rectangle/Polygon/Polyline, and 8x16 ASCII font rasterization (ExtTextOutW/DrawTextW) blitted to X11 via XPutImage.
libraries.evidence: corpus/notepad++.exe (x86-64) under winrun_gui in isolated Xvfb :91 rendering Scintilla line-number gutter, toolbar buttons, active tab bar and 6-part status bar (21 distinct colors, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-winmm
libraries.summary: timeGetTime and mmio* (RIFF files read through the caller's own I/O procedure, with the I/O buffer). No waveOut/midi on i386.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game, Mojave exterior, Pip-Boy UI and underwater/water scenes; the library appears in those runs' loader logs (WINS 8c50dda / 250e2af, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-xinput
libraries.summary: XInput 1.3/1.4/9.1.0 over host SDL2 GameController (via dlopen, with GetStateEx ordinal 100, vibration, capabilities, audio/battery queries); returns not connected when no gamepad or libSDL2 is present.

libraries.name: wins-d3d9
libraries.summary: Direct3D 9 on the host GPU through OpenGL: devices, Reset (pool/backbuffer validation and host resize), 2D/cube/volume textures, UpdateSurface and UpdateTexture, render targets, state blocks (Create/Begin/End/Capture/Apply), shader-model 3 translated to GLSL, fixed-function transform and vertex lighting (directional/point/spot, materials, ambient), clip planes, occlusion queries. Renders on the NVIDIA GPU when present.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game, Mojave exterior, Pip-Boy UI and underwater/water scenes; the library appears in those runs' loader logs (WINS 8c50dda / 250e2af, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-d3dx9

libraries.name: wins-dsound
